title: Split lint probers and adaptive release smokeflow
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: our presubmit lint runner has become a monolith that runs many language-specific probes in a single pipeline which increases flakiness and unnecessarily prolongs feedback for small changes. Similarly, release automation lacked a lightweight smoke lane for quick post-release verification which made quick rollbacks slow. This PR splits the lint probers into independent, staged probes and introduces an "adaptive release smokeflow": a short, dependency-light smoke job that runs immediately after a release and scales up to a fuller smoke run if signals are noisy. What changed: - Decomposed the monolithic lint runner into language-specific probers (js, py, go) with separate action definitions and caching heuristics; each prober is registered with the presubmit orchestrator and can be fast-failed independently; - Introduced ci/actions/lint-prober-action.yml and ci/actions/lint-prober-wrapper.sh to standardize probe entrypoints; - Added tooling to compute a minimal footprint for the smokeflow (tools/release/smokeflow/compute_profile.py) and a new smokeflow job in .github/workflows/release-smokeflow.yml that starts with a 60s warmup and increases checks when anomalies detected; - Lightweight presubmit lease extension to allow short-lived toolchain leases for heavy integration runs (ci/toolchain/lease_manager.go) so we avoid long grabs for small lint-only PRs; - Repo hygiene: removed legacy makefile targets and trimmed devcontainer profiles to only essential devdeps. Rollout plan: feature-flag the adaptive smokeflow for 72 hours in canary, run all new probers in parallel only for changes touching language-specific directories (path filters), and keep the old monolith as a fallback for one week. Checklist: [x] split probes and unit tests added; [x] smokeflow integration tests; [x] canary gating added to release pipeline; [x] docs (ci/README.md) updated. Testing: ran staged presubmit matrix on ephemeral runners (see CI logs), measured median lint feedback for small JS PRs drop from ~3m40s to ~55s in canary. Backout: rollback toggles on release pipeline and presubmit orchestrator. Related: ENG-2145 (presubmit stability), ENG-2280 (release smoke automation).

release_notes: Small: Split monolithic lint runner into language-specific probers to improve presubmit latency and reduce flakiness. Added an adaptive release smokeflow for faster post-release verification. Introduced short-lived toolchain leases to reduce resource contention for lint-only PRs. Removed legacy makefile dev targets and trimmed devcontainer. Impact: faster feedback for small PRs, small CI config additions.
